_comment: Runtime vocabulary for pcos_tools. Lists are ordered: the priority list order is the sort rank (first = highest); an empty string means a blank priority is allowed. stale_days: Stale-Triage age (days) before Archived-Auto is proposed. aged_days: Waiting/Blocked age before AGED_WAITING and the [AGED] mark. done_candidate_days: Done-Candidate age with no change before DONE_PROMOTE (-> Done) is proposed. The matching --stale-days, --aged-days and --done-candidate-days flags override these for one run. Pass --vocab PATH to use a different file.
